policy.players: exact normalized full name and IOC must identify one canonical player; duplicate source IDs merge only with identical DOB evidence; ambiguous matches remain source-scoped and flagged
policy.early_rounds: derive R128/R64/R32/R16 from full main-draw bracket slots, never from ordinal alone
policy.season: historical source season; API match calendar year as explicit fallback, override for cross-year events or match an existing edition
policy.conflicts: quarantine conflicting match outcomes; do not silently overwrite or delete missing source records
policy.missing_optional: null, never substitute current rank or invent unavailable statistics
